programme.title: No Peeking
programme.desc: 'S1/E6'. Tsholo is the head of the kitchen by day, and she is looking for her sous chef in life! Will she fall for the farmer, be attracted to the actor or be swept off her feet by the language of love?

programme.title: Sibongile & The Dlaminis
programme.desc: 'S1/E37'. Sipho falls for Velephi's lie and goes on a wild goose chase. Njengaye is unhappy to find a boy in the house and instructs Phetheni to tell Wenzeni that Steven is no longer allowed to come over.

programme.title: Nyala O...
programme.desc: 'S1/E20'. Kea discovers that her sister's generosity came at a price, leaving her questioning whom she can trust. Rhami has a counselling session with Kea's father.

programme.title: Kwa Baba
programme.desc: 'S1/E67'. Zwelakhe's heartbreak forces him to ask Bahumi difficult questions, while Dumisani's victory begins to disturb his own house. Solomon is put in his place for living in his past.

programme.title: Mnakwethu
programme.desc: 'S5/E9'. Mawande has developed a relationship outside his marriage, resulting in a son he sees as his heir. Now he wants to bring the child and his mother into his marriage, testing loyalty, legacy, and responsibility.

programme.title: Inimba
programme.desc: 'S2/E132'. Thumeka prepares for war when the custody battle suddenly turns against her. Zethu is handed the lifeline she desperately needs, while Hlathi draws a line his wife cannot cross.

programme.title: Homecoming
programme.desc: 'S2/E53'. Zethu and Msizi get closer and closer. Shwabi lures Shobane back to the bad side. The kids vow they're not missing out on the bash.

programme.title: Izingane Zes'thembu
programme.desc: 'S4/E3'. Mpumelelo juggles the demands of two relationships. Sne settles into life in Umzumbe as she embraces motherhood and a fresh start. Mthombeni gathers all his children for a family meeting.

programme.title: Nandi And The Rev
programme.desc: 'S2/E8'. Nandi sleeps out, sparking a heated confrontation between her and Rev. As Rev continues to struggle with his marriage, his friend Qali proposes a prayer meeting at the Mlombi home to help him find his way forward.

programme.title: Silent Chase
programme.desc: A hilarious film about a serial killer who wants media recognition as a killer.

programme.title: Afropop Nation
programme.desc: 'S1/E1'. Mzansi's hottest Afropop artists give intimate, soulful performances featuring their most popular songs and in-depth interviews.

programme.title: Taxi Cheeseboy
programme.desc: A cheese boy who grew up in the United States experiences a culture shock when he has to take over his father's multimillion-rand taxi business in South Africa.

programme.title: Kings Of Soweto
programme.desc: A hardened criminal who's making a name for himself in the drug world, unexpectedly falls in love with a rebellious young girl, changing his outlook on life.

programme.title: Lokshin Bioskop: Rands And Family
programme.desc: Two cash-strapped best friends rob a grocery store, but things don't go smoothly. The cops are on their trail and the two end up hiding out at a lodge.

programme.title: Imali Yegazi
programme.desc: A group of actors gather together to investigate the murder of their colleagues.

programme.title: Dana's Death-Day Party
programme.desc: A couple move into a house where the daughter of the original owners died moments before her birthday. Things start to happen in the house, causing a rift between the couple.

programme.title: Trigger Happy
programme.desc: What starts off as a simple visit to the general store becomes a day of violence, suspense and terror when three masked thugs attack the store and hold everyone hostage.

programme.title: Iphela Lase Voslo
programme.desc: A young man leaves for the city of gold, Johannesburg, in search of a better life. He then falls for a local girl who guides him through the treacherous maze of city life.

programme.desc: 'S23/E18 - Like Father Like Chef'. Three father-kid teams go head-to-head in Guy's games. To start, they must use an oversized 'Greatest Dad' mug to shop for their dad's favourite fried dish.

programme.title: Diners, Drive-Ins, And Dives
programme.desc: 'S31/E12 - Sicilian And Seafood'. Guy goes to Oklahoma City to test out the offerings from a wood-fired pizza truck. Plus, in Fort Lauderdale he enjoys Brazilian and Caribbean seafood dishes.

programme.title: Chopped Junior
programme.desc: 'S7/E5 - Champions: Part 4'. Four outstanding young cooks compete to gain a spot in the finale. The junior chefs must incorporate a guilty pleasure snack into their venison entrees.

programme.title: Restaurant Impossible: Last Call
programme.desc: 'S1/E2 - Taste Of Peru'. A father clings to old-country recipes and control in his Peruvian bistro. As he tries to change, his sons must have the confidence to take the reins.

programme.title: Outchef'd
programme.desc: 'S3/E3 - A Cut Above'. Eddie Jackson surprises home cook and lifelong fan Natalie Dargham with a steak showdown for $5,000 against celebrity chef Jeff Mauro.

programme.title: Outchef'd
programme.desc: 'S3/E4 - Wing And A Flair'. After three seasons of hosting, Eddie Jackson decides it's his time to compete against home cook Komal Montgomery. Ted Allen steps in as guest host.

programme.title: The Kitchen
programme.desc: 'S37/E6 - The Kitchen's Family Vacation'. The crew send their taste buds on vacation with savoury and sweet campfire meals, an epic road trip snack mix, a picnic pita and a boardwalk treat.

programme.title: Diners, Drive-Ins, And Dives
programme.desc: 'S37/E7 - South and South Of The Border'. Guy Fieri seeks out South flavours! He visits an old ice cream shop serving seafood in Tybee Island and then a creative taco spot in Boise.

programme.title: Chopped
programme.desc: 'S55/E9 - Military Salute Navy'. U.S. Navy chefs compete to create spectacular dishes for the chance to win $75,000 for charity. Challenges include reworking a patriotic cake for dessert.

programme.title: Martin Yan's Asian Favorites
programme.desc: 'S2/E1 - Braised Mussels'. Chef Yan makes Vietnamese-inspired braised mussels and beef cutlets for dinner guest Ili Sulaiman. Later, Chef Fazley joins Chef Yan in the kitchen.

programme.title: Martin Yan's Asian Favorites
programme.desc: 'S2/E2 - Spicy Prawn Carrot Soup'. Chef Martin Yan makes a Thai-inspired Spicy Prawn Carrot Soup and crispy Orange Ginger Duck. Indonesian Chef Marinka brings Spicy Tangy Fish.

programme.title: Food Trail: South Africa
programme.desc: 'S1/E3'. Host Warren Mendes travels through the different regions of South Africa, showcasing the country's diverse culinary landscape and culture.

programme.title: Food Trail: South Africa
programme.desc: 'S1/E4'. Host Warren Mendes travels through the different regions of South Africa, showcasing the country's diverse culinary landscape and culture.

programme.title: Extreme Cake Wars
programme.desc: 'S1/E25 - Magic'. Grab a hat and wand and prepare to cast a spell, as four amazing bakers display all the tricks needed to have their cake appear at an enchanted party celebrating magic.

programme.title: Ready Jet Cook
programme.desc: 'S1/E3 - Korean Favorites'. Jet Tila fuses cultures with his Korean short rib tacos and creates paper-thin slices of rib-eye for a spicy beef bulgogi.

programme.title: Spring Baking Championship
programme.desc: 'S10/E5 - International Spring Celebrations'. The bakers create colourful doughnuts worthy of India's Holi festival and elephant cakes inspired by Thailand's Songkran Water Festival.

programme.title: Spring Baking Championship
programme.desc: 'S10/E6 - Going To Prom'. Host Jesse Palmer is throwing a prom, and he tasks the bakers with making floral macaron corsages. Then, the bakers create tsunami prom dress cakes

programme.title: Diners, Drive-Ins, And Dives
programme.desc: 'S41/E9 - Southeast Standouts'. Guy Fieri goes on a tasty tour of the Southeast for a brisket po'boy in Louisiana, shrimp rolls in Florida, and bulgogi cheesesteaks in Atlanta.

programme.title: Diners, Drive-Ins, And Dives
programme.desc: 'S41/E10 - Barbecue, Beignets And Barbacoa'. Guy Fieri's diving into brisket injera nachos in Arlington, gluten-free beignets in Naples, and a barbacoa tortilla sandwich in Atlanta.

programme.title: Cutthroat Kitchen
programme.desc: 'S15/E1 - Fry-Day Night Bites'. American football is celebrated with sabotage such as cooking loaded nachos on a flaming halftime show stage. Former NFL pro Chad Johnson judges.

programme.title: Alex Vs America: Chefs' Cut
programme.desc: 'S2/E5 - Chef's Cut: Alex Vs Modernist'. Alex Guarnaschelli and Eric Adjepong watch as three modernist cuisine experts from across the US show Alex what they can do.

programme.title: Silos Baking Competition
programme.desc: 'S1/E6 - Silos Baking Competition Finale'. Finalists are tasked with creating unique bakery-friendly recipes to win $100,000 and the coveted spot on the Silos Baking Co.'s summer menu.

programme.title: BBQ Brawl: Flay V. Chauhan V...
Ten Tigers Of Kwangtung
programme.desc: Anti-Ch'ing revolutionary leader, Chai Min Yu, is being hunted down by Manchu General Liang. He is almost caught when a masked man rescues him from death and escapes with him.

programme.title: The Last Blood
programme.desc: The Dalai Lama and Bee's girlfriend are injured by the Red Army. Bee must find the three donors with a rare blood type within 12 hours and fight against the terrorists to save them.

programme.title: The Five Venoms
programme.desc: A dying teacher instructs his final student to check on the activities of five former pupils, each of whom he taught a unique and special style of kung-fu to.

programme.title: Helios
programme.desc: When the notorious criminal, Helios steals a powerful weapon from South Korea and attempts to sell it in Hong Kong, the police forces of these two lands must join hands.

programme.title: The Grey Men
programme.desc: Hong Kong police officer Ah Shan goes undercover to gain the trust of criminal Tian. Shan helps Tian rise to the head of his gang.

programme.title: Eye for an Eye 2
programme.desc: Blind blade master Cheng Xia Zi saves massacre survivor Zhang Xiao Yu and takes her in. As he trains her, she waits for the chance to avenge her family.

programme.title: 3AM The Campsite
programme.desc: A group of friends going on a camping trip inside a haunted forest encounters a series of paranormal events. When dawn breaks, who will get out of the forest alive?

programme.title: Life Without Principle
programme.desc: A criminal, a bank officer and a cop are forced to abandon their morals and principles to solve their financial problems.

programme.title: House of Fury
programme.desc: When their father disappears, sparring siblings Nicky and Natalie embark on a mission to look for their lost family member.

programme.title: The Brave Archer
programme.desc: Guo Jing falls in love with Huang, but Ouyang also wants to marry her. Huang's father sets a duel to decide her fate. Guo must defeat Ouyang to win Huang Rong back.

programme.title: Executioners
programme.desc: An evil deformed villain controls Hong Kong's scarce water supply, so the trio of Wonder Woman, Thief Catcher and Invisible Woman must team up and save the city.

programme.title: Ip Man 2
programme.desc: Ip Man and his family moves to Hong Kong to start a martial arts school but he must first overcome the challenges put forth to him by the local martial arts grandmasters.

programme.title: PTU
programme.desc: When a sergeant loses his police revolver to four young triad thugs, he seeks help from a PTU sergeant and his patrolling team to recover the gun and clean up the mess.

programme.title: Kung Fu Monster
programme.desc: The Bruneian Empire in the Ming Dynasty offers a monster as a gift. Despite its gentle nature, the Guard Ocean releases the monster, sparking a frantic hunt for the royal bounty.

programme.title: Iceman Cometh
programme.desc: While a royal guard pursues an evil rapist, they are accidentally frozen. Thawed out to modern-day Hong Kong, the pursuit to uphold justice continues.

programme.title: Fist of Fury
programme.desc: Master Huo's disciple Liu Jing inherits his skills. Years later, Liu confronts Blood Demon to protect Huo's clan, uphold justice, and prove his master's legacy.

programme.title: Full Alert
programme.desc: An Inspector wants to stop a huge money heist led by an escaped convict but ends up engaging in a cat-and-mouse game with him.

programme.title: Twin Dragons
programme.desc: When long-lost twins, famous pianist John and criminal Boomer, reunite in Hong Kong and accidentally swap lives, Boomer vows to save John from the clutches of gangsters.

programme.title: The Hidden Enforcers
programme.desc: A retired police officer trains four assassins to punish wrongdoers who escape conviction. However, his good intentions turn sour when the assassins kill the cops.

programme.title: The Black Panther Warriors
programme.desc: Tasked with retrieving a classified file, the mercenary Black Cougar assembles a squad of elite warriors to embark on this perilous mission.

programme.title: The Iron Fisted Monk
programme.desc: After learning kung fu from Shaolin, Husker teams up with the Iron Fisted Monk to fight against the Manchus who have killed villagers and raped women.

programme.title: The New One-Armed Swordsman
programme.desc: David Chiang plays the all-new-one-armed hero - a man who chops off his right arm rather than live with dishonour. When the love of his life is kidnapped and his best friend murdered by the gang.

programme.title: Fire of Conscience
programme.desc: Detective Manfred teams up with Inspector Kee to investigate a homicide. As corruption surfaces, Manfred unravels a web of deceit that puts the Hong Kong Police Force at risk.

programme.title: Widow Warriors
programme.desc: When the men in a triad family are betrayed and gunned down by a rival gang, their wives decide to take revenge for the death of their husbands.

programme.title: The Magnificent Butcher
programme.desc: In this classic martial arts comedy, Sammo Hung stars as Lam Sai Wing, the disciple of Wong Fei Hung, who gets embroiled in a feud with a rival kung fu school.

programme.title: The Gangster, The Cop, The Devil
programme.desc: Adapted from real events, the story is about a police special team fighting underground criminal organizations with wit and bravery, finally wiping out the enemy.

programme.title: Tiger Cage
programme.desc: A team of police officers uncover their seniors' involvement in an illegal plot after a drug operation raid. They vow to bring them to justice and root out corruption.

programme.title: The Blood Brothers
programme.desc: The friendship of three men who are close as brothers is put through the ultimate test when one of them gives in to corruption and pursues his love for his friend's wife.

programme.title: Hero
programme.desc: When two brothers escape poverty to make their fortune in Shanghai, they befriend a powerful mobster and end up battling rival gangs.

programme.title: Mr Vampire
programme.desc: When Master Ko is asked to monitor the relocation of a grave, he discovers that the corpse has become a vampire. He must now use his obscure skill to set matters right.

programme.title: Holy Flame Of The Martial World
programme.desc: A popular tale of a brother and sister seeking vengeance for the death of their parents through the mythical yin/yang holy flame technique is a visual epic.

programme.title: Righting Wrongs
programme.desc: A lawyer decides to take the law into his own hands when a witness and his family are murdered.

programme.title: Madlanga Commission
